name: team_planning_timeline_figures
description: Get the figures for each column of one path of a Team Planning plan the caller is in, the path team_planning_timeline lays out, root first. Each figure is the one the step's own tool gives. cost is team_planning_cost's: for Today (basis run_rate) the yearly run rate of its seats, for a step (basis period) its seats and forecast over its period. unpriced counts the seats left out of cost, for any reason; team_planning_cost lists each with its reason. budget is team_planning_budget's total: approved, funded and unfunded, each with its money and head count, and over; Today has none, as it has no period. capacity is team_planning_capacity's total per capacity model, the step's own and its forecast. Figures are decimal strings. A budget line's amount is pay: money is false for a caller without the plan's see-pay right, who gets band midpoints in cost, every head count, and null for every budget amount, native, converted and missing. An archived plan carries archived_on, priced_on and a note: its figures use the pay bands, exchange rates, budget lines and rules as they stood on priced_on, its archive day, while framework roles and levels are read as they are now. A plan archived before that copy was kept, or read where its copy can't be opened, has no priced_on, and its figures use today's. Restoring a plan prices it with today's again. A step with no end date runs, for its figures, over the plan's open_step_horizon rule in whole months from its start: its period's ends_on is that horizon's last day, with open_ended true and horizon_months the months shown. Otherwise open_ended is false and horizon_months null. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: The last step, or the plan's id for the baseline alone.
